talent_changes.change: Frostfire Bolt: new level-40 spell, 3 s cast, counts as Fire and Frost, uses higher Fire/Frost spell damage and lower target resistance, DoT + movement slow.
Comprehension: new Mage-only minor tradeskill; Comprehend Scroll (General tab) reads scrolls dropped in the world.
Mage Armor: mana regeneration bonus from Spirit increased (50% while casting per bindonforever/Wowhead).
Frost Blast (added Oct 16 at level 24) removed.

Various talents no longer have a reduced proc chance from low-rank spells; the penalty still applies to Blizzard (reduced chance to trigger Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost when the rank was learned >12 levels below the caster).
Arcane Blast: new 11-pt gold medal, 2.5 s cast, buff to other spells + own mana cost, 4 stacks, 8 s or until another spell is cast.

Arcane Blast redesigned: 1.5 s cast, +15% Intellect as spell damage per stack, 15 s from first application. Arcane Wrath added as 16-pt gold medal (3.5 s cast, +5% max mana as spell power, 6 s CD). Missile Barrage moved to row 1 as a 2-pt talent.

Arcane Blast: mana cost increase per stack 100% (was 175%), 12% of Intellect as spell damage per stack (was 15%), duration 18 s. Missile Barrage moved to row 2; Arcane Resilience to row 1 (3 pts, 75% Int as armor); Arcane Focus removed (merged into Precision); Clearcasting no longer consumed by Arcane Missiles while Missile Barrage is active.

Arcane Meditation now requires Arcane Concentration; Arcane Power requires Presence of Mind; Arcane Instability no longer requires Presence of Mind; Arcane Mind increases Intellect and Arcane crit damage; Arcane Impact boosts crit of all Arcane spells; Arcane Geometry new (range).
Arcane Blast duration fixed to 18 s (hotfix).

Heating Up (new row 4, requires Pyroblast): crits with Fireball/Frostfire Bolt/Fire Blast/Scorch cut next Pyroblast cast 25%/stack, max 3 (1.5 s Pyroblast). Ignite per-Mage. Improved Scorch only benefits the caster. Blast Wave no longer requires Pyroblast. Incineration also affects Ice Lance and Arcane Blast.

Heating Up always gains a charge from Fire Blast (2 on crit) and is not consumed when Presence of Mind is used; Wake of Fire reverted to Improved Fire Blast (+8/15 yd range, no kill bonus); Fire Power redesigned (1/2/3% per Fire effect, max 12%).
Improved Fireball renamed Accelerant (also -0.5 s on Arcane Wrath); Incineration 5 pts for 10% crit; Critical Mass back to 3 pts (6%); Improved Fire Blast moved to row 3.

Ice Lance new 11-pt gold medal (+300% vs Frozen); Fingers of Frost new row 5 (requires Ice Lance); Ice Block 16-pt; Cold Snap 21-pt with 10 min CD; Improved Blizzard slow max 40%; Permafrost %-based; Winter's Chill self-only; Shatter no longer requires Improved Frost Nova.
Ice Lance vs Frozen reduced to +200%; Winter's Chill redesigned to empower Cone of Cold (stacks to 5, consumed by Cone of Cold); Cone of Cold slows first 4 targets 10% more and 3 s longer.

Piercing Ice removed; Ice Barrier +15% Frost damage for 1 min on cast and +5% while it holds; Frost Warding boosts Ice Barrier/Frost Ward absorbs; Elemental Precision renamed Precision (3 pts, 2/4/6% hit with all spells); Ice Lance 8 s cooldown shared with Fire Blast, back to +300% vs Frozen; Winter's Chill +20% Cone of Cold damage per stack.

rotations.arcane: Arcane Fire (raid): open Pyroblast, build 4 Arcane Blast stacks and refresh within 18 s. Priority: Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up > Fire Blast on cooldown (until 3 Heating Up) > Arcane Wrath on cooldown > Arcane Missiles with Missile Barrage > Arcane Blast to keep 4 stacks. AoE: pre-pull Flamestrike, Blink in, Arcane Explosion on cooldown, Presence of Mind + Flamestrike when the first one ends (8 s).
rotations.arcane_leveling: Max range: Frostbolt (slow) > Arcane Wrath > Arcane Blast 1-3x until Missile Barrage > Arcane Missiles > Frost Nova > Arcane Wrath > Fire Blast > wand to finish. Let Arcane Blast drop (cost +100% per stack). Use Clearcasting on multi-stack Arcane Blast or Arcane Wrath. AoE: gather, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Arcane Explosion spam (not on 3 or fewer mobs).
rotations.fire: Deep Fire (Combustion): open Pyroblast, Scorch to 5 Improved Scorch stacks (refresh within 30 s). Priority: Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up > Fire Blast on cooldown (1 stack guaranteed, 2 on crit; each stack -1.5 s Pyroblast cast) > Arcane Blast (keep 1-2 stacks) > Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage > Fireball filler > Scorch to maintain the debuff. AoE: Flamestrike, Blink in, Blast Wave on cooldown > Cone of Cold > Flamestrike (8 s) > Arcane Explosion.
rotations.fire_leveling: Max range: Frostfire Bolt / Pyroblast (Fireball before you have them) > Arcane Blast 1-2x until Missile Barrage > Arcane Missiles > Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up > Fire Blast on cooldown > Scorch filler > wand under ~15% or when out of mana. AoE: Frost Nova, Flamestrike, Blast Wave (or Cone of Cold), Arcane Explosion; don't overlap slows; Mana Shield only near death.
rotations.frostfire: Frostfire Bolt build: open Pyroblast, Scorch to 5 stacks. Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up > Fire Blast on cooldown > Frostfire Bolt until 3 Heating Up > Scorch to maintain. On Fingers of Frost, batch an instant (preferably Fire Blast) with the 2nd stack. AoE: Flamestrike, Blink in, Blast Wave > Cone of Cold (can proc Fingers of Frost) > Flamestrike > Arcane Explosion.
rotations.frost: Pre-pull: Arcane Intellect, Ice Armor or Mage Armor, Ice Barrier at pull, precast Frostbolt. Priority: at 5 Winter's Chill stacks batch Cone of Cold with the next Frostbolt > at 1 Fingers of Frost stack batch Ice Lance with Frostbolt > (Frostbite builds) frozen target: batch Ice Lance > recast Ice Barrier when Frigid Power has <=3 s > Frostbolt. AoE 3+: Cone of Cold on cooldown, Cold Snap to reset it, Blizzard filler.
rotations.frost_leveling: Max-range Frostbolt; keep Arcane Blast at 1 stack (buff); react to procs: Frostbite freeze on hit -> Frostbolt + batched Ice Lance (Cone of Cold if Ice Lance is on cooldown); Fingers of Frost on cast -> Frostbolt, then Frostbolt + batched Ice Lance on the 2nd stack. Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage. Frost Nova and back up when enemies close in; Fire Blast or wand to finish.
rotations.mana: Five-second rule: spending mana stops Spirit regen for 5 s (wand finishing lets it resume sooner; wanding doesn't interrupt it). Mage Armor keeps 50% of Spirit regen while casting and Arcane Meditation 3/3 another 50% (100% in combat from ~level 34, Icy Veins). Regen formula 13 + Spirit/4 every 2 s (Wowhead). MP5 always applies. Evocation restores most mana over 8 s (use near ~5% mana; Spirit improves it). Conjure food, water and a mana gem at login; Major Mana Potion has a 2 min cooldown.

professions.comprehension: Comprehension is a new Mage-only minor tradeskill that lets Mages read and decipher scrolls dropped by creatures in the world; 'various benefits are provided by these that players will discover in their adventures' (Blizzard). Comprehend Scroll is the ability used to attempt Comprehension, found in the General tab of the spellbook (Blizzard). Datamined: skill line 3012, a Secondary Skill like Cooking, Mage-only (class mask 128) from level 6; Comprehend Scroll (spell 1296017, 'Decipher an untranslated scroll') learned at level 6; scrolls are consumed when read (bindonforever). Icy Veins: used to gain unique buffs, temporary effects and additional on-use items exclusive to Mage. Wowhead: scrolls drop for players and only Mages can use Comprehend Scroll on them, like lockboxes for Rogues; a 'Research' spell (1310041) appeared in beta but was removed (unconfirmed). Blizzard has not said what the scrolls grant.
